items.what: FOMC rate decision under Chair Warsh. Economists expect a hold before the midterms, with a December hike possible to fight inflation.
items.expected: Federal Reserve calendar: Oct 27-28 meeting, decision 2:00 pm and press conference 2:30 pm ET Oct 28 (Gray DC preview)
items.happened: On Oct 28 the FOMC held the funds rate at 3.75–4.00% by a 10–2 vote, Warsh's first decision as Chair. Cook and Hammack dissented in favour of a hike. https://admiralmarkets.com/analytics/traders-blog/warsh-press-conference-october-2026

items.what: Judge Carter's TRO hearing on DOJ's request to set aside about 20,000 California mail ballots. The Ninth Circuit dismissed DOJ's premature appeal 2-1 on Oct 26 (event a1), so the case now rests with Carter, and a DOJ trip to the Supreme Court is possible.
items.expected: US District Court C.D. Cal., hearing Tuesday Oct 27; Ninth Circuit opinion https://cdn.ca9.uscourts.gov/datastore/opinions/2026/10/26/26-7070.pdf
items.happened: Judge Carter refused DOJ's request on Oct 28. On Nov 2 the Supreme Court denied DOJ's emergency application in a one-line order. https://www.cbsnews.com/news/supreme-court-rejects-trump-california-mail-ballots-alleged-noncitizens/

items.what: Ruling on the motion to dismiss DOJ's Alaska certification suit, filed Oct 25 by Peltola and the DSCC before Judge Sharon Gleason, plus any hearing date
items.expected: Peltola asked Judge Gleason to rule this week (Reuters, Oct 26)
items.happened: On Nov 1 Judge Gleason dismissed the DOJ suit seeking to block certification of Alaska's Senate race. https://www.adn.com/politics/2026/11/01/judge-throws-out-trump-ordered-lawsuit-seeking-to-block-certification-of-alaskas-us-senate-race/

items.what: Midterm election day. Control of the House (218-214 R) and Senate (53-47 R) is at stake.
items.expected: Nov 3
items.happened: Networks project that Democrats won both the House and Senate. Mississippi and Alaska were still uncalled on Nov 5 (event E-261105-01). https://www.nbcwashington.com/elections/election-day-after-2026-midterms-congress-results-live-updates/4177248/

items.what: Whether Trump orders new strikes on Iran before Nov 3. CNN reports forces are ready within 96 hours of an order and that officials see after the midterms as likelier. Also watch Qatari and regional mediation.
items.expected: CNN via Times of Israel, Oct 26; Trump on Fox Oct 25 said he is weighing 'deal or finish them off'
items.happened: No pre-election strike campaign was reported. Axios (via Gulf News) reports a US strike on Qeshm Island on Nov 3. Qatar-mediated talks continue, and Trump says he is in 'no rush'. https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-weighs-iran-strikes-or-deal-after-midterm-loss-as-vance-urges-agreement-qatar-mediates-brent-oil-falls-to-93-1.500736556

items.what: Status conference for Cole Tomas Allen, accused of the White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting, to set a trial date
items.expected: Thursday Oct 29 (Gray DC)

items.what: Revised Section 338 scope takes effect Oct 30. Also watch for a possible narrow US-Canada deal easing Section 232 steel and auto tariffs before Nov 3.
items.expected: Reuters Oct 26 (Canadian source says a pre-election deal is possible); White House fact sheet sets the Oct 30 effective date
items.happened: No US–Canada steel and auto deal was found. The revised Section 338 list took effect Oct 30, and the White House says Canada 'walked away'. https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2026/10/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-further-modifies-canadian-products-subject-to-tariffs-under-section-338/

items.what: Supreme Court November argument session begins. The October sitting appears to be over, but I could not open the calendar PDFs.
items.expected: supremecourt.gov lists a session starting Nov 2
items.happened: The November sitting opened Nov 2 (Maxwell v. Dinis). Guerrero v. Johnson was argued Nov 4. https://www.supremecourt.gov/oral_arguments/argument_calendars/MonthlyArgumentCalNovember2026.pdf

items.what: The Senate budget committee takes up the tax reform. Watch whether it restores the CIT rise and removes PIT indexation, and the Sejm's later vote on any Senate amendments.
items.expected: Committee chair Kleina (Interia) expects it on Monday 26 October. The full Senate has 30 days.
items.happened: On 26 October the Senate budget committee backed Kleina's amendments restoring the CIT rise and removing PIT indexation (WNP/PAP: https://www.wnp.pl/rynki/podatkowy-zwrot-akcji-senacka-komisja-zmienia-kurs-ws-pit-i-cit-chodzi-o-dwie-wazne-poprawki,1113016.html). The full Senate and the Sejm votes are tracked in a new watch item.

items.what: Tusk names a new minister of funds and regional policy. Watch whether the post goes to Polska 2050 or Hołownia carries out his threat to withdraw the party's ministers, and a possible new vote on mayoral term limits.
items.expected: Tusk said he would announce the choice after returning from India. Rzeczpospolita expects a decisive week.
items.happened: Tusk nominated EU sherpa Agnieszka Bartol after consulting Hołownia. Her appointment papers were still with President Nawrocki on Nov 5. https://www.polsatnews.pl/wiadomosc/2026-10-27/premier-wskazal-nowego-ministra-ma-zastapic-pelczynska-nalecz/

items.what: NBP Monetary Policy Council (RPP) decision with its new inflation projection. Some economists (Pekao) and market pricing see a possible hike from 3.75%.
items.expected: RPP meeting on 3–4 November 2026 (Bankier.pl, RPP calendar).
items.happened: On Nov 4 the RPP held the reference rate at 3.75%. The new projection puts 2027 CPI at 3.1–5.3%, assuming fuel caps end on Dec 31. https://tvn24.pl/biznes/z-kraju/stopy-procentowe-w-polsce-w-listopadzie-2026-rpp-podjela-decyzje-st9321601

items.what: The Senate votes on the two abortion bills, then the President decides whether to sign or veto.
items.expected: The KO MP (Polsat) expects a veto. The Senate sitting date is not yet confirmed.

items.what: The 'coalition of the willing' exercise takes place in Poland and the Black Sea region. Watch for exact dates and Polish participation.
items.expected: November 2026, per Polsat citing DW and The Times.

items.what: The PM appoints a commissioner for Częstochowa and an early mayoral and council election is called.
items.expected: Follows the 25 October recall (PKW).
items.happened: On Nov 5 Tusk named KO deputy mayor Łukasz Pabiś as Częstochowa's commissioner. The early election date is not yet set (due within 90 days). https://www.polsatnews.pl/wiadomosc/2026-11-05/decyzja-premiera-po-referendum-w-czestochowie-wyznaczyl-komisarza/

items.what: Whether Kraków suspends its partnership with Lviv. On 21 October, Mayor Gibała proposed suspending it after the Lviv Oblast Council declared 2027 the Year of the UPA and Shukhevych. The draft goes through two readings and will be withdrawn if the Ukrainian side reverses its decision. Przemyśl, Wrocław and Lublin have also protested.
items.expected: Two readings at the City Council; next ordinary session on 18 November (KRKnews, PAP Samorząd).

items.what: Second reading and vote on the 20- and 40-minute ticket resolution
items.expected: City Council session on 18 November; changes would apply from January 2027 (M jak Małopolska).

items.what: Answered on 26 October. Order 2251/2026 (in force from 23 October) moves department duties to existing units. Deputy mayor Hoffman oversees ZTP, ZDMK and municipal companies; Kois-Żurek oversees education, social welfare, housing and the new Health Office (from 1 December). Source: https://krknews.pl/nowy-podzial-kompetencji-w-krakowie-gibala-rozdzielil-nadzor-nad-transportem-metrem-edukacja-i-spolkami/
items.expected: Can be closed. Linked event: a1. Sources close to the mayor call the division of duties temporary (LoveKraków).
items.happened: Answered 26 Oct: order 2251/2026 split supervision of city units (incl. ZTP, ZDMK and education) among the three deputy mayors; see https://www.bip.krakow.pl/

items.what: Gibała's first draft budget for 2027
items.expected: Draft due by 15 November and first reading by 2 December, per the timetable the council set on 21 October.

items.what: All Saints' Day peak: full special timetable and road closures around the cemeteries
items.expected: ZTP: 30 October to 2 November.
items.happened: The All Saints' special timetable and closures ran as planned (Oct 30–Nov 2). https://krknews.pl/wszystkich-swietych-2026-w-krakowie-cmentarze-otwarte-dluzej-specjalne-linie-mpk-i-zmiany-w-ruchu/

items.what: The EC has now responded in court: its Oct 26 affidavit says SIR orders were unanimous. Still watch the Oct 30 'public impeachment' at Hotel Ashok and the Nov 1 Ramlila Maidan rally.
items.expected: Congress/INDIA bloc per ThePrint; Lamba says the rally will not be postponed
items.happened: Rain moved the 'public impeachment' to Oct 31 at Kharge's residence, with 19 parties. The Nov 1 Ramlila Maidan rally demanded the CEC's resignation; there is no independent crowd count. https://www.siasat.com/india-bloc-holds-cecs-public-impeachment-at-kharge-residence-3567592/

items.what: Whether Kharge or Congress apologises or clarifies; outcome of BJP protests and the Patna police complaint
items.expected: BJP protests called for Oct 26
items.happened: BJP held protests in several states on Oct 26. Kharge has not apologised; Congress (Gehlot) defends the remark as an idiom aimed at the RSS. A BJP complaint was filed in Patna, but no FIR has been reported. https://theweek.in/news/india/2026/10/26/kharges-remark-on-pm-modis-father-snowballs-into-major-political-row-bjp-holds-protests-across-country.html

items.what: Whether Saudi flights resume and the Centre sends special flights. Air India/AI Express have suspended Riyadh and Dammam to Nov 7 and Jeddah to Oct 31; IndiGo has cancelled to Oct 31. No Centre special flights so far.
items.expected: Airline schedules per ETV Bharat (Hindi) / ANI
items.happened: On Oct 30 Air India and AI Express extended their Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam suspensions to Nov 14, with free rebooking or refunds. No special evacuation flights were reported. https://www.republicworld.com/india/air-india-suspends-flights-connecting-india-and-saudi-arabia-till-november-14-2026-10-30-140060

items.what: Modi–Prince Alois talks are scheduled for Oct 27 at Hyderabad House. Check for any agreements or TEPA investment announcements in the MEA readout.
items.expected: MEA programme per IANS
items.happened: Delegation-level talks were held on Oct 27. No agreements or investment figures were announced. https://openthemagazine.com/india/pm-modi-holds-delegation-level-talks-with-liechtensteins-hereditary-prince-alois

items.what: Oil-driven market weakness: the Oct 26 close and the trend in Brent
items.expected: Business Today market coverage
items.happened: Markets closed higher on Oct 26 (Sensex +483 to 73,607), ending a four-day slide, while Brent stayed near $114.50 and the rupee fell to 95.19. https://hdfcsky.com/news/market-close-report-today-october-26-2026-sensex-nifty-rise-as-markets-snap-four-day-losing-streak

items.what: Jamia: written timeline for the students' union constitution and elections
items.expected: Students' demand per ANI
items.happened: After an 18-day hunger strike, Jamia agreed to frame a union constitution by May 15, 2027 and hold elections by August 2027. https://www.republicworld.com/india/jamia-agrees-to-students-union-elections-by-august-2027-after-18-day-hunger-strike-students-celebrate-2026-10-30-140002

items.what: Findings of the MeitY team probing the eMudhra certificate-key compromise (disclosed around Oct 21)
items.expected: MeitY per ThePrint
items.happened: MeitY's preliminary view is that Indian DSC and eSign services are unaffected. eMudhra quit SSL/TLS on Oct 22, its audit report is due mid-to-late November, and no penalties have been imposed. https://inc42.com/features/emudhra-has-quit-tls-the-accountability-questions-havent/

items.what: Jaishankar at the G20 FMM in Atlanta and a possible Quad foreign ministers' meeting; any Rubio–Jaishankar bilateral or trade-deal signal (State Dept formally announced the 30–31 Oct meeting on 26 Oct; Sikorski also attends)
items.expected: State Dept announcement 26 Oct; IANS says Quad FMs meet on margins; no bilateral schedule released
items.happened: Jaishankar met Rubio in Atlanta on Oct 31. No Quad foreign ministers' meeting was held there. https://www.outlookindia.com/national/jaishankar-meets-marco-rubio-at-g20-in-atlanta-reviews-india-us-cooperation

items.what: Whether the India–US trade deal is signed, possibly at a Modi–Trump meeting during the ASEAN summit in Manila, alongside a Quad leaders' summit
items.expected: Trump/Rubio say deal is close; Manila meetings 15–18 Nov

items.what: US Europe force-posture review: report to Hegseth around 1 Nov, to Trump around 1 Dec; decision on a permanent US base and its location
items.expected: Polish MoD (Kosiniak-Kamysz, Sobkowiak-Czarnecka)
items.happened: The review has not been released. Böll expects results in December at the earliest, and Kosiniak-Kamysz says Poland's base documents go to the Pentagon in November. https://us.boell.org/en/2026/10/30/much-ado-about-us-force-posture-review

items.what: Rescheduled Kosiniak-Kamysz–Hegseth Pentagon meeting (postponed in September at US request)
items.expected: WP sources: October or November

items.what: Signing of the Poland–India Agreement on Mutual Protection and Exchange of Classified Information, and confirmation of WB Group's India investment
items.expected: Joint statement of 22 Oct says 'soon'

items.what: Anthropic IPO roadshow, price range and Nasdaq listing (ticker ANT)
items.expected: WSJ sources via TNW: listing possibly the week of Nov 16

items.what: CDC Ebola attestation requirement for all inbound international air passengers takes effect. Watch airline implementation and any expansion to more countries.
items.expected: CDC order: flights departing at or after 11:59 pm EST Nov 3
items.happened: The CDC attestation order took effect at 11:59pm EST on Nov 3. Separate entry suspensions for DRC, Uganda and South Sudan run to Nov 10. https://www.eckertseamans.com/stay-informed/blogs/aviation/cdc-requires-ebola-related-attestation-from-all-air-travelers-arriving-in-the-u-s

items.what: World Series Game 4. The Brewers lead 3-0 and can clinch their first title.
items.expected: Oct 27, 8 pm ET, Tropicana Field (NBC/ESPN)
items.happened: The Brewers won Game 5 on Oct 28 (4–1 in the game and 4–1 in the series) for their first World Series title. https://okcfox.com/news/nation-world/gallery/brewers-beat-the-rays-4-1-in-game-5-to-win-their-first-world-series-title?photo=1

items.what: Full Senate vote on the PIT/CIT reform with the Kleina amendments, then the Sejm vote on the Senate amendments (absolute majority needed to reject them).
items.expected: LEX says the Senate plenary vote is on Tuesday 27 October; Senate sitting scheduled for 27 October (Portal Samorządowy). Sejm date not known.
items.happened: On Oct 27 the Senate passed 8 amendments, 62–0–23. Because of constitutional doubts, the government did not take them to a Sejm vote and filed a near-identical new bill instead, which passed first reading Nov 5 (event E-261105-18). https://finwire.pl/artykuly/reforma-pit-2027-sejm-od-nowa-5-listopada-drugi-prog-130-tys-zl

items.what: GUS flash CPI estimate for October 2026, ahead of the RPP decision.
items.expected: Finwire economic calendar: 30 October 2026.
items.happened: GUS flash CPI for October was 3.5% y/y and −0.4% m/m; motor fuels fell 9.7% m/m. https://bank.pl/?p=563828

items.what: CCD2 consumer-credit rules start to apply. Watch whether Poland adopts its implementing law or misses the date.
items.expected: Directive 2023/2225 application date 20 November 2026; Wprost says Poland will not be ready.

items.what: First Polish arms contracts with Vietnam (Krab howitzers, Rosomak/Borsuk vehicles, ammunition).
items.expected: Deputy minister Konrad Gołota (Notes from Poland); a Wprost headline says first contracts are possible this year.

items.what: Opening of the S7 viaducts through Nowa Huta (Mistrzejowice) to traffic
items.expected: GDDKiA says end of October; LoveKraków estimates 30 or 31 October. The link to S52 is due in late November or early December.
items.happened: The S7 viaducts at the Mistrzejowice junction opened Oct 30, partly at reduced speed. The remaining carriageway and S7/S52 links are due late Nov or early Dec. https://www.gov.pl/web/gddkia-krakow/jazda-po-estakadach

items.what: Councillor Michał Starobrat's plan to close the roughly 390 million zł gap in this year's current spending without new debt
items.expected: Gibała gave him two weeks from about 23 October (KRKnews, 23 October).

items.what: Residents' appeal against the permit for UKEN's shooting range at Fort Bronowice
items.expected: Councillor Tomasz Pytko says residents will appeal within a week of the decision (Radio Kraków, 26 October).
items.happened: Residents announced an appeal, but no filing was confirmed. Machinery entered the site around Nov 3 and park access is restricted from Nov 4. https://radiokrakow.pl/wiadomosci/krakow/mimo-protestow-mieszkancow-koparki-wjechaly-do-bronowic-uken-buduje-strzelnice/187264

items.what: Launch of the City Hall Health Office and the competition to choose its head
items.expected: The office starts on 1 December under order 2251/2026, according to deputy mayor Kois-Żurek (Radio Kraków).

items.what: Supreme Court (CJI Surya Kant bench) hearing on pleas against CEC Gyanesh Kumar (Rakesh Kumar Singh v. UoI) after the EC affidavit; any interim order
items.expected: Listed for Oct 27 per LiveLaw/Organiser
items.happened: The bench deferred the pleas by 10 days for rejoinders, and they are likely to be listed around Nov 17. It issued notice on a related CEC-immunity plea on Nov 4. https://www.wionews.com/india-news/sc-defers-pleas-against-cec-gyanesh-kumar-by-10-days-petitioners-get-time-to-respond-to-eci-1793091410675

items.what: Cyclone Arnab landfall on the Andhra Pradesh–Yanam coast (Bapatla–Visakhapatnam): damage, casualties, evacuation
items.expected: IMD forecast via ANI: landfall by Oct 28 forenoon
items.happened: Arnab made landfall on Oct 28. Seven deaths were reported in Andhra Pradesh and more than 180,000 people were evacuated. https://kathmandupost.com/world/2026/10/29/cyclone-arnab-kills-seven-in-andhra-pradesh-as-heavy-rain-hits-eastern-india

items.what: Jio Platforms listing on NSE/BSE: listing price versus Rs 1,119 issue price
items.expected: Listing Oct 28 per IPO Watch/Groww
items.happened: Listed Oct 28 at Rs 1,358, a 21.4% premium to the Rs 1,119 issue price. https://groww.in/blog/jio-platforms-shares-list-at-21-36-premium-on-nse-bse

items.what: ISRO GSLV-F18 launch of NavIC satellite NVS-03 from Sriharikota
items.expected: Oct 30, 23:51 IST per CSR Journal/NewsBytes
items.happened: GSLV-F18 placed NVS-03 in its intended orbit (around Oct 30–31). https://morungexpress.com/marks-important-step-in-strengthening-navic-pm-modi-congratulates-isro-scientists-on-successful-launch-of-gslv-f18-carrying-nvs-03

items.what: Signing of the India–EU FTA
items.expected: Goyal (ANI, Oct 22): signing before year-end, operational in 4–5 months

items.expected: PAP/WNP 26 Oct: Sikorski to represent Poland; meeting 30–31 Oct
items.happened: Sikorski spoke at an Oct 30 press conference in Atlanta. No bilateral meeting with Rubio and no remarks on the base were reported. https://defence24.pl/geopolityka/polska-ma-duzo-do-powiedzenia-sikorski-z-przeslaniem-do-lawrowa

items.what: Final results in the Mississippi (Colom v. Hyde-Smith) and Alaska (Peltola v. Sullivan) Senate races, including any legal challenge in Mississippi.
